newsitem.title: USA: World Access says intl products will help.
newsitem.headline: World Access says intl products will help.

text.p: World Access Inc said Tuesday its new proprietary international products will generate new sales and improve gross profit margins for the beginning in the second half of 1997."
The company said the intial target market for these products are in Latin America and the Caribbean.
The company said it has already begun shipping these products.
The company reported first quarter income of $2.6 million, or $0.15 per share, compared to $1.2 million, or $0.09 per share, for the same period a year ago.
